photos_one_owner.name: photos_one_owner
photos_one_owner.value: (("photos"."object_id" IS NULL) <> ("photos"."todo_id" IS NULL)) OR ("photos"."object_id" IS NULL AND "photos"."todo_id" IS NULL AND "photos"."draft_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "photos"."inline")

todos_time_needs_date.name: todos_time_needs_date
todos_time_needs_date.value: "todos"."due_time" IS NULL OR "todos"."due_date" IS NOT NULL

todos_start_before_due.name: todos_start_before_due
todos_start_before_due.value: "todos"."start_date" IS NULL OR "todos"."due_date" IS NULL OR "todos"."start_date" <= "todos"."due_date"
